summary: A Mexican software developer who was recently laid off is considering freelancing or starting their own company in Finland. They are unsure about the legal implications of resigning from their current job and transitioning to a freelance or entrepreneurial status. The advisor suggests visiting the Migree website for information on resignation permits and legal status. They mention the need to apply for an entrepreneur visa. The advisor is in the process of looking up relevant entrepreneurship visa information. The next step is for the advisor to provide details on the visa application process and legal requirements for freelancers or entrepreneurs in Finland.

questionnaire.Contents of the customer visit: Matters related to immigration process (eg.: residence permit)
questionnaire.Any other Feedback: The customer is currently unemployed, recently laid off from a tech company as a software developer, and is considering freelancing or starting their own company to secure a contract with a new firm instead of being hired as a full-time employee. They are unsure about the legal and tax implications of self-employment in Finland and are concerned about the process of changing their residence permit from a worker permit to an entrepreneur permit.
